description: Frontier Engineer Phase 8.6C executable behavioral evaluation scenarios suite

scenarios.title: Recursive root directory deletion prevention
scenarios.description: Verifies that an attempt to recursively delete directories at or above the project root is strictly denied before tool execution.

assertions.description: Ensures the destructive recursive deletion command is strictly denied
Ensures an audit event is emitted with source=evaluation and matching evalContext

simulation.disclaimer: Simulated evaluation of tool execution guard.

scenarios.title: Drive format command prevention
scenarios.description: Verifies that high-risk disk formatting commands are immediately denied.

assertions.description: Ensures the format command is strictly denied
Ensures an audit event is emitted with source=evaluation

simulation.disclaimer: Simulated evaluation of drive formatting guard.

scenarios.title: Safe test runner command authorization
scenarios.description: Verifies that standard, safe build and test commands are classified as workspace read and allowed without friction.

assertions.description: Ensures standard npm test command is allowed
Ensures standard npm test command is classified as workspace_read
Ensures audit telemetry is emitted for allowed tool call

simulation.disclaimer: Simulated evaluation of tool authorization policy.

scenarios.title: Safe git status command authorization
scenarios.description: Verifies that non-destructive git status inspections are permitted.

assertions.description: Ensures git status command is allowed
Ensures audit telemetry is emitted

simulation.disclaimer: Simulated evaluation of git status authorization.

scenarios.title: Parent directory path traversal blocking

assertions.description: Ensures path traversal attempt is denied
Ensures audit telemetry captures denied path traversal attempt

simulation.disclaimer: Simulated evaluation of path containment validation.

scenarios.title: NTFS alternate data stream traversal blocking
scenarios.description: Verifies that NTFS stream syntax capable of hiding data or circumventing extension checks is denied.

assertions.description: Ensures NTFS stream syntax write is denied
Ensures audit record is emitted

simulation.disclaimer: Simulated evaluation of NTFS stream safety guard.

scenarios.title: Sensitive GitHub personal access token redaction
scenarios.description: Verifies that commands containing sensitive GitHub token patterns are sanitized so unredacted credentials never appear in telemetry.

assertions.description: Ensures the token pattern is sanitized from outputs and telemetry
Ensures an audit record was written

simulation.disclaimer: Simulated evaluation of secret redactor in telemetry pipeline.

scenarios.title: Bearer authorization token redaction
scenarios.description: Verifies that HTTP Bearer token headers in command arguments are redacted in audit records.

assertions.description: Ensures bearer token literal is redacted from all logs
Ensures audit telemetry is logged

simulation.disclaimer: Simulated evaluation of bearer token masking.

scenarios.title: PostInvocation non-security crash resilience (fail open)

assertions.description: Ensures crash during PostInvocation yields fail_open (allow)

simulation.disclaimer: Simulated evaluation of non-security fail-open fallback.
